channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jarred Vanderbilt | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jarred Vanderbilt from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on Jarred Vanderbilt
item.description:
Justin Russo:Ivica Zubac, on the incident with Jarred Vanderbilt:

“I was just protecting my shoulder. A guy pulled my shoulder and got to protect myself.”

Ivica Zubac on Jarred Vanderbilt, Jan 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dorian Finney-Smith on Jarred Vanderbilt
item.description:
“Me, Gabe, Rui [Hachimura], [Jarred Vanderbilt], just recipients of them playing well.”

Dorian Finney-Smith on Jarred Vanderbilt, Mar 30, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Jaylen Brown, Jarred Vanderbilt
item.description:
“That’s the dumbest thing I’ve ever heard… So Jaylen Brown don’t play defense?… [Jarred Vanderbilt plays defense].”

Gilbert Arenas on Jaylen Brown, Jarred Vanderbilt, Aug 8, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Jarred Vanderbilt
item.description:
LeBron James on Jarred Vanderbilt:

“I mean, it's the Vando we grew accustomed to when we got him last year, and obviously, the injuries put a hurting on him early in the season, but he's getting back into form, and that's the Vando we've been missing.”

LeBron James on Jarred Vanderbilt, Jan 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Jarred Vanderbilt
item.description:
After the game, Ham said Taurean Prince and Rui Hachimura would undergo evaluations Sunday, perhaps clearing the way for one or both to get back on the court Monday in Miami against the Heat.

“It definitely helps when you have bigger bodies. I mean, we have three of our bigger bodies out right with injuries in Rui, [Jarred Vanderbilt] and TP. So, I mean, it would help,”

LeBron James on Jarred Vanderbilt, Nov 5, 2023. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: LeBron James on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt, Malik Beasley
item.description:
LeBron on the Lakers since the trade deadline (they’re 4-1 since acquiring Russell, Vanderbilt and Beasley):

“I feel like we’re in a good place. We’re gonna try to continue that.”

LeBron James on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt, Malik Beasley, Feb 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Rob Pelinka:

“We are thrilled to add D’Angelo, Malik and Jarred to our organization and are confident their talents will boost our ability to finish the season strongly. In this trade, we’ve added switchable wing defending, perimeter shooting and rebounding depth.”

Rob Pelinka on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt, Feb 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Jarred Vanderbilt, Michael Porter
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Tim Connelly on Michael Porter Jr., who’s SL debut is around the corner:

“He’s been in the gym twice a day for a long time. He’s been fully cleared for several months. Him and Jarred (Vanderbilt) have pushed each other…He resembles the player we saw prior to all the injuries.”

Tim Connelly on Jarred Vanderbilt, Michael Porter, Jun 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
